method: Manual outlines traced from the supplied construction-stage Piazza images at 800x500 before inspecting model comparisons; rasterized to 1600x1000. No model-derived masks or mesh extraction. N/W/top visible envelopes; E/S explicitly cropped visible upper portions to exclude foreground HRSC/adjacent roofs. Street unavailable because tile fractures and the adjacent red building obscure the target boundary. Eight orbits are visual-only. Approximately 5–10 annotation-pixel uncertainty. Elementum tile IoU unavailable: pre-development imagery.
